summary: Retained Physics Lab runtime synthesis #408 authenticates canonical entries but does not close the recipe.entities container key-space: a plain canonically ordered list with an added hash field is ignored by both length and ipairs traversal and can pass the canonical-recipe fence. Draft docs PR #501 records the bounded dense-array-shape follow-up. This is distinct from #451 realization values, #467 outer wrapper schema closure, and #494 ordering.
evidence: At #408 exact product head d31c100c5d3766ca14d89b046fff4cdb09086754, assertCanonicalRecipe() requires recipe.entities to be a plain table, checks #entities against the canonical population, then traverses entries only with ipairs(). It does not inspect all container keys.

The synthesis regression tests reject a metatable-backed entity-list wrapper and exercise population/key/id/provenance/state/revision mismatches, but the inspected corpus does not add an otherwise inert hash/non-array field to the plain entities container.

PR #467 closes undeclared fields at the top-level recipe and individual EntityRecipe wrappers; PR #494 closes canonical entry ordering. Neither finding covers undeclared keys on the array container itself.

Draft PR #501 exact head 598488c7b600b8a1c3771c26b58b21ee26023663 changes only Docs/PHYSICS_LAB_RUNTIME_ENTITY_LIST_SHAPE.md. No local Luau/Lune or Roblox Studio execution is claimed; canonical GitHub CI is required for publication evidence.
